THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY, OCTOBER 10, 1936.
D. 7559
10 10 36

“NO LONGER DISUNITED,”
SAYS GENERALISSIMO

China Capable of Setting Her Own House in Order:
Wants Chance to Work Out Her Own Destiny

MESSAGE TO ENGLISH READING PUBLIC

Asks to Be Left Without Interruption or Embarrass-
ment: Advancing Cause of World Peace

Nanking, Oct. 9.
“CHINA is capable of doing great deeds by her own efforts,
capable of wiping out destructive forces of militarism,
capable of undertaking constructive measures for the welfare
of her people; in short, capable of setting her own house in order,
provided she is given the chance to work out her destiny uninter-
rupted and unembarrassed.” This is the message of Gen. Chiang
Kai-shek, president of the Executive Yuan, and chairman of the
Military Affairs Commission, to the English-reading public both
in China and abroad, in commemoration of the founding of the
Chinese Republic.
“This chance we want and this chance we must have,” the
Generalissimo declared. “To give China an opportunity for in-
ternal development is not only to render her indirect friendly
assistance, but also to advance the cause of world peace, because,
with her peace-loving millions and her unlimited resources, China,
once prosperous and strong, will be one of the greatest stabilizing
influences in the family of nations.”

Choosing “China’s Unification and
Reconstruction” as the theme of his
National Day greetings, Gen. Chiang
calls the attention of all foreign
friends to the fact that “China to-day
is no longer the disunited country of
the past years.” At present, he says,
Communism is no more a real menace
to China.
Outlining the rapid strides achieved
by the Government in various fields
of endeavour, Gen. Chiang emphasizes
that, “against great odds, China is
forging ahead in the execution of
her programme of national recon-
struction. Nor is it in economic re-
construction alone that China has
made progress. Great efforts are also
being made to improve the efficiency
of public administration, promote
public health, enforce compulsory
education, and to bring about finan-
cial reforms.”

D. 7559
1936年10月10日

“不再分裂”，
委员长称

中国有能力整顿内部秩序：
希望有机会自主决定命运

致英语读者的文告

请求不受干扰或尴尬地行事：推进世界和平事业

南京，10月9日。
“中国有能力通过自身努力成就伟业，有能力消除军阀主义的破坏力量，有能力采取建设性措施以造福人民；简言之，只要给予中国不受干扰和阻碍地决定自身命运的机会，中国就有能力整顿内部秩序。”这是行政院院长兼军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军，为纪念中华民国成立，向国内外英语读者发出的文告。
“我们需要这个机会，也必须拥有这个机会，”委员长宣称。“给予中国内部发展的机会，不仅是间接地提供友好援助，也是推进世界和平事业，因为拥有热爱和平的亿万民众和无限资源的中国，一旦繁荣强大，将成为国际大家庭中最伟大的稳定力量之一。”

蒋将军以“中国的统一与重建”作为其国庆致辞的主题，提请所有外国朋友注意这样一个事实：“今日之中国已不再是过去几年那个分裂的国家。”他说，目前共产主义已不再是中国真正的威胁。
蒋将军概述了政府在各个努力领域取得的快速进展，他强调，“尽管困难重重，中国仍在推进其国家重建计划的执行。中国取得的进步不仅限于经济重建。政府也在大力提高公共行政效率，促进公共卫生，推行义务教育，并实施财政改革。”

At 9 a.m. October 10, a ceremony to mark the completion
of the construction of the new N.S.R. and S.H.N.R. Administra-
tion Building, North Station Road, will be held on the new
premises.

In celebration of the festival, members of the Chinese
Y.M.C.A. will hold a dinner party in the new building at
123 Boulevard de Montigny at 6.30 p.m. October 9.

Labour

Hung Tsang Cotton Mill - situation

In connection with the dispute between the workers
and the management of the Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381
Markham Road, which arose when the management dismissed
two workers for organizing a labour union (Vide I.R.
2/10/36), 162 of the 850 night shift workers failed to report
for duty on the night of October 8/9, and 173 of the day
shift absented themselves this morning, October 9.

The management has decided to dismiss nine workers
who are believed to have instigated the agitation. It is
learned that their dismissal will be announced on the
evening of October 9.

Miscellaneous

Chinese boyscouts leave for Nanking

A further batch of about 120 Chinese boyscouts from
various schools in Canton left the Shanghai North Station
for Nanking by rail at 11 p.m. October 8 for the purpose
of participating in the rally to be held on October 10.

THE DOUBLE TENTH ANNIVERSARY

of

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：-

双十节纪念日

10月10日是中华民国成立25周年纪念日，本地塘沽总部将于当日上午10时，在南市民众教育馆（文教路）召集本地各公共团体代表开会庆祝。报馆、银行、海关、邮局、法院、大型工厂和商行将放假一天。全区将悬挂国旗。

鉴于当前局势紧张及谣言盛行，华界和租界的警察当局将在当天采取预防措施。
